verses.sloka: अनुज्ञातंस्तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।उत्पपात महामेघः श्वसनेनोद्धतो यथा ।। ६.१२६.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: anujñātaṁstu rāmeṇa tadvimānamanuttamam ।utpapāta mahāmeghaḥ śvasanenoddhato yathā ।। 6.126.1 ।।

translations.english: Swan shaped Pushpak, unsurpassed in appearance like swan, making great sound started to fly with the permission of Rama.
translations.hindi: कन ग्रष्टादशोचरशततमः सगः र्‍ण:0$--- ७. ९ ® पे तां तु पाश्वस्थितां प्रह्वां रामः सम्प्रेक्ष्य मेथिलीम । हृदयान्तगतक्रोधो व्याहनगुपचक्रमे

verses.sloka: पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः ।अब्रवीन्मैथिलीं सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम् ।। ६.१२६.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: pātayitvā tataścakṣuḥ sarvato raghunandanaḥ ।abravīnmaithilīṁ sītāṁ rāmaḥ śaśinibhānanām ।। 6.126.2 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Raghu race casting his gaze at the moon like face of Sita spoke.
translations.hindi: वे कहने लगे- हे भद्रे ! मैंने युद्ध में शत्र को परास्त कर सुमको पुनः प्राप्त कर लिआ । पुरुषार्थ जो किया जा सकता था चह मेंने कर दिखाया

verses.sloka: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम् ।लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ।। ६.१२६.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharākāre trikūṭaśikhare sthitām ।laṅkāmīkṣasva vaidehi nirmitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 6.126.3 ।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi, you may see the peak of Trikuta which stands on Lanka in the shape of the peak of Kailasa, constructed by Viswakarma."
translations.hindi: अब मेरा क्रोध नष्ट हुआ । रावण ने तुमको हर कर मेरा जो अनादर किआ था उस अनादर का बदला भी प्रा हो चका | शत्रु ने जो अनादर को बातें कही थीं, उस अनाद्र के वहः मेंने युद्ध में शकु का वध कर डाला । श्रथवा यद्ध में उस अनादर को आर अनादर करनेवाले शत्र को साथ ही नष्ट कर्‌ डाला

verses.sloka: एतदायोधनं पश्य मांसशोणितकर्दमम् ।हरीणां राक्षसानां च सीते विशसनं महत् ।। ६.१२६.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: etadāyodhanaṁ paśya māṁsaśoṇitakardamam ।harīṇāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca sīte viśasanaṁ mahat ।। 6.126.4 ।।

translations.english: "Sita, see the mire of flesh and blood of the carnage of many monkeys and Rakshasas on the battlefield."
translations.hindi: आज लोगों ने मेरा पुरुषार्थ देख लिआ। आज मेरा सारा परिश्रम सफल हुआ । आज मैं अपनी प्रतिज्ञा से पार हुआ और आज में स्वतन्त्र हो गया

verses.sloka: अत्र दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः ।तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि रावणो निहतो मया ।। ६.१२६.५ ।।कुम्भकर्णो ऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः ।धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता ।। ६.१२६.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: atra dattavaraḥ śete pramāthī rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।tava hetorviśālākṣi rāvaṇo nihato mayā ।। 6.126.5 ।।kumbhakarṇo 'tra nihataḥ prahastaśca niśācaraḥ ।dhūmrākṣaścātra nihato vānareṇa hanūmatā ।। 6.126.6 ।।

translations.english: "Broad eyed Sita, there lies Ravana, the Rakshasa king, who by virtue of boon tortured people, destroyed by me on your account."

verses.sloka: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना ।। ६.१२६.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vidyunmālī hataścātra suṣeṇena mahātmanā ।। 6.126.7 ।।

translations.english: "There lies Kumbhakarna, the night ranger killed by me, Prahastha killed by Vanaras, DhumRaksha killed by Hanuman."
translations.hindi: जो मनुष्य अपने निरादर को अपने बल विक्रम से दूर नहीं कर सका ; उसका पुरुषार्थ हो किस काम का । ऐसा मनुष्य तो. अल्पबल ओर अल्पविक्रम बाला सममा जाता हे

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिर्निहतो रणे ।अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः ।। ६.१२६.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇenendrajiccātra rāvaṇirnihato raṇe ।aṅgadenātra nihato vikaṭo nāma rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.126.8 ।।

translations.english: "There lies Vidyunmali killed by great Sushena and Ravana's son Indrajith killed by Lakshmana in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: समुद्र का नाँघना, लङ्का को विध्वस्त करना आदि हनुमान्‌ जी ने जो बड़े बड़े सराहने योग्य काय किए, वे सब आज सफल हो गए

verses.sloka: विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनो ऽन्ये च राक्षसाः ।। ६.१२६.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: virūpākṣaśca durdharṣo mahāpārśvamahodarau ।akampanaśca nihato balino 'nye ca rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.126.9 ।।

translations.english: "There is the Rakshasa by name Vikata killed by Angada, and Virupaksha (killed by Sugriva), Mahaparsva (killed by Rshaba), Mahodara (killed by Neela), Akampana and other Rakshasas, like Trisira killed by the mighty Hanuman and Atikaya by Lakshmana and Devanthaka (by Hanuman), and Naranthaka (by Angada)."
translations.hindi: युद्ध मै पराक्रम प्रदर्शित करने वाले और सदा हितयुक्त परासशै ( सलाह देने वाले सुग्रीव का तथा उनकी सेना का भी सारः परिश्रम आज सफल हुआ

verses.sloka: अत्र मण्डोदरी नाम भार्या तं पर्यदेवयत् ।सपत्नीनां सहस्रेण सास्रेण परिवारिता ।। ६.१२६.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: atra maṇḍodarī nāma bhāryā taṁ paryadevayat ।sapatnīnāṁ sahasreṇa sāsreṇa parivāritā ।। 6.126.10 ।।

translations.english: "There is the Rakshasa by name Vikata killed by Angada, and Virupaksha (killed by Sugriva), Mahaparsva (killed by Rshaba), Mahodara (killed by Neela), Akampana and other Rakshasas, like Trisira killed by the mighty Hanuman and Atikaya by Lakshmana and Devanthaka (by Hanuman), and Naranthaka (by Angada)."

verses.sloka: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थं समुद्रस्य वरानने ।यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम् ।। ६.१२६.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: etattu dṛśyate tīrthaṁ samudrasya varānane ।yatra sāgaramuttīrya tāṁ rātrimuṣitā vayam ।। 6.126.11 ।।

translations.english: "Yuddhonmatta and Matta both Rakshasa chiefs, and also Nikumbha and Kumbha, sons of Kumbhakarna (killed by Hanuman and Sugriva), and Vajradamshtra and Damshtra (killed by Angada), and Maha raksha who was difficult to encounter was killed by me in the combat."
translations.hindi: बहुत दिनों बाद श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के दशेन पाने से ) सीता जी के नेत्र हिरनो की तरह प्रफल्लित हो गए थे, किन्तु श्रीराम चन्द्र द जी के इन वचनों को सुन, उन नेत्रो में आँसु भर आए

verses.sloka: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे सलिलार्णवे ।तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः ।। ६.१२६.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa seturmayā baddhaḥ sāgare salilārṇave ।tava hetorviśālākṣi nalasetuḥ suduṣkaraḥ ।। 6.126.12 ।।

translations.english: "Yuddhonmatta and Matta both Rakshasa chiefs, and also Nikumbha and Kumbha, sons of Kumbhakarna (killed by Hanuman and Sugriva), and Vajradamshtra and Damshtra (killed by Angada), and Maha raksha who was difficult to encounter was killed by me in the combat."
translations.hindi: उस समय सीता को देख कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का क्रोध पुनः उसी प्रकार भड़का, जिस प्रकार घी डालने से अग्नि धघक उठता है

verses.sloka: पश्य सागरमक्षोभ्यं वैदेहि वरुणालयम् ।अपारमभिगर्जन्तं शङ्खशुक्तिनिषेवितम् ।। ६.१२६.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: paśya sāgaramakṣobhyaṁ vaidehi varuṇālayam ।apāramabhigarjantaṁ śaṅkhaśuktiniṣevitam ।। 6.126.13 ।।

translations.english: " Akampana and also Sonithaksha got killed (by Dwivida), Yupaksha and Prajaghna (by Mainda and Angada)."
translations.hindi: उनकी भोहें चढ़ गई । उन्होंने टेढ़ी निगाह' मोहि चढ़ डु ह्‌ से सीता को शकी और राक्षसो के सामने, सीता जी से ये ही 2 Ml कहे

verses.sloka: हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि ।विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम् ।। ६.१२६.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyanābhaṁ śailendraṁ kāñcanaṁ paśya maithili ।viśramārthaṁ hanumato bhittvā sāgaramutthitam ।। 6.126.14 ।।

translations.english: "There is Vidyujihva of dreadful appearance killed, Yajnasatru killed, and the mighty Suptaghna. Similarly Suryasatru and another Rakshasa Brahmasatru were killed. in the shape of the peak of Kailasa."
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! देखो अपना अपमान दूर करने के लिए मनुष्य कों जो कुछ करना उचित है, बह मैंने ( रावण को मार कर ) दिख- लाया । मेने क्रो६ कर शत्रु के हाथ से तुम्हारा उद्धार वैसे ही किआ ; जैसे आत्मस्वरूप को जानने बाले अगस्त्य ने दुधेषे दक्षिण दिशा का, राक्षो के हाथ से उद्धार किआ था

verses.sloka: एतत् कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् ।। ६.१२६.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: etat kukṣau samudrasya skandhāvāraniveśanam ।। 6.126.15 ।।

translations.english: "Mandodari wife of Ravana, with a thousand cowives is on the seashore surrounded by associates."

verses.sloka: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थं सागरस्य महात्मनः ।सेतुबन्ध इति ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येनाभिपूजितम् ।एतत् पवित्रं परमं महापातकनाशनम् ।। ६.१२६.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: etattu dṛśyate tīrthaṁ sāgarasya mahātmanaḥ ।setubandha iti khyātaṁ trailokyenābhipūjitam ।etat pavitraṁ paramaṁ mahāpātakanāśanam ।। 6.126.16 ।।

translations.english: "Charming lady! You see the seashore there, where we crossed the sea that night and slept on the shore."
translations.hindi: दे भद्रे ! तुमको यह भो जान लेना चाहिए कि, इत इष्ट मित्रों ही के बल पराक्रम से मैं प्रग्राम के परिश्रम से पार हुआ हूँ। किन्तु मैंने यह परिश्रम ( केवल ) तुम्हारे लिए ही नहीं: उठाया

verses.sloka: अत्र पूर्वं महादेवः प्रसादमकरोत् प्रभुः ।। ६.१२६.१७ ।।ि ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येनाभिपूजितम् ।अत्र राक्षसराजो ऽयमाजगाम विभीषणः ।। ६.१२६.१८ ।।१७ ।।ि ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येनाभिपूजितम् ।एषा सा दृश्यते सीते किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना ।सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या यत्र वाली मया हतः ।। ६.१२६.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: atra pūrvaṁ mahādevaḥ prasādamakarot prabhuḥ ।। 6.126.17 ।।i khyātaṁ trailokyenābhipūjitam ।atra rākṣasarājo 'yamājagāma vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.126.18 ।।17 ।।i khyātaṁ trailokyenābhipūjitam ।eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte kiṣkindhā citrakānanā ।sugrīvasya purī ramyā yatra vālī mayā hataḥ ।। 6.126.19 ।।

translations.english: "Broad eyed lady! Here is the bridge built on the salty ocean by Nala, which was difficult to construct."
translations.hindi: किन्तु ( रावण को मार कर ) मैने अपने चरित्र की रक्षा की है ओर अपनी बदनामी को बचाया है तथा अपने विख्यात बंश के अपयश को घो बहाया हे

verses.sloka: अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरीं सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम् ।अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा ।। ६.१२६.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā purīṁ sītā kiṣkindhāṁ vālipālitām ।abravīt praśritaṁ vākyaṁ rāmaṁ praṇayasādhvasā ।। 6.126.20 ।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi! See the abode of Varuna, impenetrable and immeasurable roaring aloud filled with conches and oystershells."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे है सीते ! तुम्हारे चरित्र में सन्देह उत्पन्न हो गया हे अतः सुम मेरे सामने खड़ी हुई मेरे लिए उसी प्रकार असह्य हो रद्दी हो, जिस प्रकार नेत्ररोग से पीड़ित मनुष्य को सामने रखा हुआ दीपक असह्य जान पड़ता है

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप ।अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम् ।गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानीं त्वया ऽनघ ।। ६.१२६.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvapriyabhāryābhistārāpramukhato nṛpa ।anyeṣāṁ vānarendrāṇāṁ strībhiḥ parivṛtā hyaham ।gantumicche sahāyodhyāṁ rājadhānīṁ tvayā 'nagha ।। 6.126.21 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili! See the mountain which has golden caves and has risen cleaving the ocean in order to give place for Hanuman to rest while crossing the ocean."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो ऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम् ।एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः ।विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ६.१२६.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamukto 'tha vaidehyā rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca tām ।evamastviti kiṣkindhāṁ prāpya saṁsthāpya rāghavaḥ ।vimānaṁ prekṣya sugrīvaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 6.126.22 ।।

translations.english: "Here is a cavern where all these troops were stationed before crossing the ocean. At this place Lord MahaDeva bestowed his grace on me (before construction of the bridge)."

verses.sloka: ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सर्वान् वानरपुङ्गवान् ।स्वदारसहिताः सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया ।। ६.१२६.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: brūhi vānaraśārdūla sarvān vānarapuṅgavān ।svadārasahitāḥ sarve hyayodhyāṁ yāntu sītayā ।। 6.126.23 ।।

translations.english: "See in the middle of the ocean a very popular spot which is worshipped by the three worlds. It is supremely sacred known by the name Sethubandha. It is capable of removing all sins. It is here that the Rakshasa king Vibhishana came to meet me."
translations.hindi: अतः रावण की गोद में बैठ चुकी द्य र्‌ हुईं, उसकी कुदृष्टि । हुई तुमको, इतने बड़ कुल में उत्पन्न होकर क क्यों कर ग्रहण करू ?

verses.sloka: तथा त्वमपि सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल ।अभित्वरस्व सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगेश्वर ।। ६.१२६.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā tvamapi sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha mahābala ।abhitvarasva sugrīva gacchāmaḥ plavageśvara ।। 6.126.24 ।।

translations.english: "See in the middle of the ocean a very popular spot which is worshipped by the three worlds. It is supremely sacred known by the name Sethubandha. It is capable of removing all sins. It is here that the Rakshasa king Vibhishana came to meet me."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा ।वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः ।। ६.१२६.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo rāmeṇāmitatejasā ।vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmāṁstaiśca sarvaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ।। 6.126.25 ।।

translations.english: "Sita! You are seeing the capital of Sugriva, beautiful Kishkinda with lovely woods. Vali was killed here by me."
translations.hindi: हे भद्रे ! मैंने निश्चय करके तुमसे यह कहा हे । लक्ष्मण भरत, वानरेन्द्र सुग्रीव अथवा राक्षसेन्द्र विभोषण में से, जिसके यहाँ तुम रहना पसन्द करो या जहां तुम्हें सुव मिलने को आशा हो, वहां तुम रह सकती हो

verses.sloka: प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रं तारामुद्वीक्ष्य भाषत ।। ६.१२६.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: praviśyāntaḥpuraṁ śīghraṁ tārāmudvīkṣya bhāṣata ।। 6.126.26 ।।

translations.english: Sita, seeing the beautiful Kishkinda city ruled by Vali, gazing at Rama timidly and through love spoke to him.

verses.sloka: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीभिर्वानराणां महात्मनाम् ।राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया ।। ६.१२६.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: priye tvaṁ saha nārībhirvānarāṇāṁ mahātmanām ।rāghaveṇābhyanujñātā maithilīpriyakāmyayā ।। 6.126.27 ।।

translations.english: "O King! I wish to go to the capital city Ayodhya with you, Tara and other consorts of Sugriva, and other women, surrounded by Vanara chiefs."
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! तुम्हारा दिव्य और मनोहर रूप देख रावण ने जो चाहा होगा सो किया होगा, क्योंकि तुम उसके घर में बहुत दिनों से रहती -ही थीं

verses.sloka: त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः ।अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः ।। ६.१२६.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvara tvamabhigacchāmo gṛhya vānarayoṣitaḥ ।ayodhyāṁ darśayiṣyāmaḥ sarvā daśarathastriyaḥ ।। 6.126.28 ।।

translations.english: "O King! I wish to go to the capital city Ayodhya with you, Tara and other consorts of Sugriva, and other women, surrounded by Vanara chiefs."
translations.hindi: गो० १२६२ युद्धकाण्डे बहुत दिनों से प्यारे वचन सुनने की आशा लगाए हुए सीता श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मुख से इस प्रकार के अप्रियवचन सुन कर गजेन्द्र द्वारा झकमोरी हई लता (विशेष) की तरह थरथर कॉपने लगी और नेत्रो से अश्र बिन्दु टपकाने लगीं.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना ।आहूय चाब्रवीत् सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः ।। ६.१२६.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvasya vacaḥ śrutvā tārā sarvāṅgaśobhanā ।āhūya cābravīt sarvā vānarāṇāṁ tu yoṣitaḥ ।। 6.126.29 ।।

translations.english: Vaidehi having spoken like that, Raghava replied her saying 'So be it' and Raghava stopped Pushpaka at Kishkinda, looked at Sugriva and spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīveṇābhyanujñātā gantuṁ sarvaiśca vānaraiḥ ।।

translations.english: "Sugriva, the tiger among Vanaras! Let all Vanara chiefs and all women too collected, proceed to Ayodhya. Sita desires you to go."

verses.sloka: मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च ।। ६.१२६.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: mama cāpi priyaṁ kāryamayodhyādarśanena ca ।। 6.126.30 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva the head of the monkeys said" all of you including women also have to go quickly."

verses.sloka: प्रवेशं चापि रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह ।विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च ।। ६.१२६.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: praveśaṁ cāpi rāmasya paurajānapadaiḥ saha ।vibhūtiṁ caiva sarvāsāṁ strīṇāṁ daśarathasya ca ।। 6.126.31 ।।

translations.english: When Rama of immeasurable energy had spoken in the aforesaid manner, Sugriva, the prosperous leader of Vanaras, surrounded by the monkeys entered the gynaeceum and looking at Tara said.

verses.sloka: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः ।नेपथ्यं विधिपूर्वेण कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् ।अध्यारोहन् विमानं तत् सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षया ।। ६.१२६.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tārayā cābhyanujñātāḥ sarvā vānarayoṣitaḥ ।nepathyaṁ vidhipūrveṇa kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam ।adhyārohan vimānaṁ tat sītādarśanakāṅkṣayā ।। 6.126.32 ।।

translations.english: When Rama of immeasurable energy had spoken in the aforesaid manner, Sugriva, the prosperous leader of Vanaras, surrounded by the monkeys entered the gynaeceum and looking at Tara said.

verses.sloka: ताभिः सहोत्थितं शीघ्रं विमानं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः ।ऋश्यमूकसमीपे तु वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् ।। ६.१२६.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tābhiḥ sahotthitaṁ śīghraṁ vimānaṁ prekṣya rāghavaḥ ।ṛśyamūkasamīpe tu vaidehīṁ punarabravīt ।। 6.126.33 ।।

translations.english: "Dear, you have been duly permitted by the great soul Raghava to go to Ayodhya with Vanaras and also women to gratify Mythili."

verses.sloka: दृश्यते ऽसौ महान् सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः ।ऋश्यमूको गिरिश्रेष्ठः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः ।। ६.१२६.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate 'sau mahān sīte savidyudiva toyadaḥ ।ṛśyamūko giriśreṣṭhaḥ kāñcanairdhātubhirvṛtaḥ ।। 6.126.34 ।।

translations.english: "You hasten the wives of the monkeys. Taking all of them we shall depart to Ayodhya and shall see the consorts of Dasharatha."

verses.sloka: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः ।समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थं वालिनो मया ।। ६.१२६.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: atrāhaṁ vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ ।samayaśca kṛtaḥ sīte vadhārthaṁ vālino mayā ।। 6.126.35 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Sugriva's words, Tara of beautiful limbs spoke, summoning all women.

verses.sloka: एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनी चित्रकानना ।त्वया विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः ।अस्यास्तीरे मया दृष्टा शबरी धर्मचारिणी ।। ६.१२६.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā sā dṛśyate pampā nalinī citrakānanā ।tvayā vihīno yatrāhaṁ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ ।asyāstīre mayā dṛṣṭā śabarī dharmacāriṇī ।। 6.126.36 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva has permitted all the Vanaras to go with wives and look at Ayodhya." Dear, some kindly act will be done for us also."

verses.sloka: अत्र योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो निहतो मया ।। ६.१२६.३७ ।।विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः ।दृश्यते च जनस्थाने सीते श्रीमान् वनस्पतिः ।यत्र युद्धं महद्वृत्तं तव हेतोर्विलासिनि ।रावणस्य नृशंसस्य जटायोश्च महात्मनः ।। ६.१२६.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: atra yojanabāhuśca kabandho nihato mayā ।। 6.126.37 ।।vihīno yatrāhaṁ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ ।dṛśyate ca janasthāne sīte śrīmān vanaspatiḥ ।yatra yuddhaṁ mahadvṛttaṁ tava hetorvilāsini ।rāvaṇasya nṛśaṁsasya jaṭāyośca mahātmanaḥ ।। 6.126.38 ।।

translations.english: "We shall see with all the citizens, Rama's entry into Ayodhya, Dasharatha's women and the glory of Ayodhya, everything."

verses.sloka: खरश्च निहतो यत्र दूषणश्च निपातितः ।त्रिशिराश्च महावीर्यो मया बाणैरजिह्मगैः ।एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि ।। ६.१२६.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kharaśca nihato yatra dūṣaṇaśca nipātitaḥ ।triśirāśca mahāvīryo mayā bāṇairajihmagaiḥ ।etattadāśramapadamasmākaṁ varavarṇini ।। 6.126.39 ।।

translations.english: Duly permitted, all Vanaras wives and Tara also decorated themselves according to tradition, went around the Pushpaka and looked forward to seeing Sita.

verses.sloka: पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शना ।यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात् ।। ६.१२६.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: parṇaśālā tathā citrā dṛśyate śubhadarśanā ।yatra tvaṁ rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt ।। 6.126.40 ।।

translations.english: After Rama and all others ascended and Pushpaka rose up speedily over the Rshyamuka, gazing at Rshyamuka, Rama spoke toVaidehi.

verses.sloka: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शिवा ।अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो ह्येष दृश्यते पश्य मैथिलि ।। ६.१२६.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā godāvarī ramyā prasannasalilā śivā ।agastyasyāśramo hyeṣa dṛśyate paśya maithili ।। 6.126.41 ।।

translations.english: "Sita! Rshyamuka is seen covered with streaks of gold minerals, glowing like clouds with lightning."

verses.sloka: दीप्तश्चैवाश्रमो ह्येष सुतीक्ष्णस्य महात्मनः ।। ६.१२६.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dīptaścaivāśramo hyeṣa sutīkṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 6.126.42 ।।

translations.english: "Here is the place I met the Vanara king Sugriva and made an agreement to put an end to Vali."

verses.sloka: वैदेहि दृश्यते चात्र शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान् ।उपयातः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरन्दरः ।। ६.१२६.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vaidehi dṛśyate cātra śarabhaṅgāśramo mahān ।upayātaḥ sahasrākṣo yatra śakraḥ purandaraḥ ।। 6.126.43 ।।

translations.english: "Here is seen lovely woods and Pampa waters. I lamented here, separated from you."

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् देशे महाकायो विराधो निहतो मया ।। ६.१२६.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: asmin deśe mahākāyo virādho nihato mayā ।। 6.126.44 ।।

translations.english: "On its bank (Pampa) I saw Sabari, who was following the righteous path. Kabhanda, of eight miles long arms, was killed by me."

verses.sloka: एते हि तापसावासा दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे ।अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानप्रभः ।अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी ।। ६.१२६.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ete hi tāpasāvāsā dṛśyante tanumadhyame ।atriḥ kulapatiryatra sūryavaiśvānaprabhaḥ ।atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharmacāriṇī ।। 6.126.45 ।।

translations.english: "Sita, here is Janasthana, where a mighty tree is seen. Oh sportive lady! There the exceptionally strong and highly energetic vulture Jatayu got killed by Ravana on account of you."

verses.sloka: असौ सुतनु शैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते ।यत्र मां केकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः ।। ६.१२६.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: asau sutanu śailendraścitrakūṭaḥ prakāśate ।yatra māṁ kekayīputraḥ prasādayitumāgataḥ ।। 6.126.46 ।।

translations.english: "Sita, here is Janasthana, where a mighty tree is seen. Oh sportive lady! There the exceptionally strong and highly energetic vulture Jatayu got killed by Ravana on account of you."

verses.sloka: एषा सा यमुना दूराद्दृश्यते चित्रकानना ।। ६.१२६.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā sā yamunā dūrāddṛśyate citrakānanā ।। 6.126.47 ।।

translations.english: "O excellent lady! Here is the location where Khara was killed by my straight going arrows and Dushana had fallen. Here is our hermitage covered with leaves, a well known site. It is from here that Ravana had borne you away forcibly."

verses.sloka: भरद्वाजाश्रमो यत्र श्रीमानेष प्रकाशते ।। ६.१२६.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: bharadvājāśramo yatra śrīmāneṣa prakāśate ।। 6.126.48 ।।

translations.english: "O excellent lady! Here is the location where Khara was killed by my straight going arrows and Dushana had fallen. Here is our hermitage covered with leaves, a well known site. It is from here that Ravana had borne you away forcibly."

verses.sloka: एषा त्रिपथगा गङ्गा दृश्यते वरवर्णिनि ।नानाद्विजगणाकीर्णा सम्प्रयुष्पितकानना ।। ६.१२६.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā tripathagā gaṅgā dṛśyate varavarṇini ।nānādvijagaṇākīrṇā samprayuṣpitakānanā ।। 6.126.49 ।।

translations.english: "Here is an auspicious, beautiful Godavari with pure water. Here is also seen the hermitage of Agastya surrounded by banana plants."

verses.sloka: शृङ्गिवेरपुरं चैतद् गुहो यत्र समागतः ।। ६.१२६.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: śṛṅgiverapuraṁ caitad guho yatra samāgataḥ ।। 6.126.50 ।।

translations.english: "See the glowing hermitage of the great sage Sutikshna. Vaidehi, see Sarabhanga's hermitage here, where the thousand eyed Indra, the destroyer of citadels (Purandara) had come."

verses.sloka: एषा सा दृश्यते सीते सरयूर्यूपमालिनी ।नानातरुशताकीर्णा सम्प्रपुष्पितकानना ।। ६.१२६.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte sarayūryūpamālinī ।nānātaruśatākīrṇā samprapuṣpitakānanā ।। 6.126.51 ।।

translations.english: "See the glowing hermitage of the great sage Sutikshna. Vaidehi, see Sarabhanga's hermitage here, where the thousand eyed Indra, the destroyer of citadels (Purandara) had come."

verses.sloka: एषा सा दृश्यते ऽयोध्या राजधानी पितुर्मम् ।अयोध्यां कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता ।। ६.१२६.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣā sā dṛśyate 'yodhyā rājadhānī piturmam ।ayodhyāṁ kuru vaidehi praṇāmaṁ punarāgatā ।। 6.126.52 ।।

translations.english: "There are seen the abodes of ascetics. Here was seen by you hermitage of Atri (whose wife Anasuya you had seen) glowing like sun and fire."

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ।उत्पत्योत्पत्य ददृशुस्तां पुरीं शुभदर्शनाम् ।। ६.१२६.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।utpatyotpatya dadṛśustāṁ purīṁ śubhadarśanām ।। 6.126.53 ।।

translations.english: "In these countries was a Rakshasa, called Viradha of gigantic size who was killed by me. There is an ascetic woman Anasuya practicing virtues whom you saw."

verses.sloka: ततस्तु तां पाम्डुरहर्म्यमालिनीं विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिसङ्कुलाम् ।पुरीमयोध्यां ददृशुः प्लवङ्गमाः पुरीं महेन्द्रस्य यथा ऽमरावतीम् ।। ६.१२६.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu tāṁ pāmḍuraharmyamālinīṁ viśālakakṣyāṁ gajavājisaṅkulām ।purīmayodhyāṁ dadṛśuḥ plavaṅgamāḥ purīṁ mahendrasya yathā 'marāvatīm ।। 6.126.54 ।।

translations.english: "O Charming lady! See the best of the mountains Chitrakuta shining there. Kaikeyi's son had come here to request me to accept the kingdom."

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaḍviṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 126 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili! See the wonderful woods bordering beautiful Yamuna. Glorious hermitage of Bharadwaja is seen there."
